# Feedback buttons

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

A feedback button lets you provide feedback with a single click. The button triggers a feedback collection action. This component can easily integrate user feedback into the app.

## Example

![Example](/img/feedback-buttons-appcard.png)

    "content": {
        "settings": {},
        "body": [

}
